candidates.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
candidates.summary: Give your agents access to hundreds of tools while using fewer tokens with Tool Retrieval, now in preview in the Gemini API.

candidates.title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider, so you can connect the open source coding agent to models like Kimi K3.1 Pro using your standard AWS credential chain (named profiles or SSO) instead of a separate API key. This post shows how to configure the provider and send your first request.

candidates.title: Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
candidates.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments now supports AWS Marketplace, so agents can discover and buy x402-enabled products, APIs, data, and content and pay in USD on the developer's AWS bill, with no stablecoin wallets or API keys. This post walks through a research agent that finds a tool, pays per request through AWS Billing, and answers with sources.

candidates.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
candidates.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

candidates.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
candidates.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

candidates.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
candidates.summary: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.
